# swimlane fixtures

All written for this engine. The grammar follows the Mermaid swimlanes page
(https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/swimlanes.html).

- `library-loan.mmd`, `incident.mmd`, `purchase.mmd`, `release-vertical.mmd`:
  everyday processes covering labelled links, a decision with a back edge,
  a chain, a fork into two lanes and a top-to-bottom layout.
- `cjk-styled.mmd`, `minimal.mmd`: CJK text, lane ids with titles, a nested
  subgraph folded into its lane, a step outside every lane, link styles and
  author styles.
